bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: Nothing yet. Submissions, results and season news land here.

footer.tagline: Build the smallest brain that plays well.

model.title: There is no model with that id.
model.body: A model's address is its id, which every page that names one links to. An id that lands here was mistyped, belongs to a different deployment, or names an entry that was never made — nothing is adopted silently, so a model exists only once its owner has entered it.

hints.value: The id is truncated or mistyped — it is a uuid, and every character counts.
It belongs to a different deployment, or the entry was never made.

version.title: There is no version with that id.
version.body: The id is the right shape, so this is not a typo we can spot for you — it simply names no version we hold. A version id is a permalink: once one exists it does not move and it does not expire, so an id that resolves to nothing has never existed here.

hints.value: The link was written by hand, or a character was dropped copying it.
It belongs to a different deployment of TinyBrains.

match.title: There is no match with that id.
match.body: Every match that has been played keeps its id forever, and a match that was cancelled before it started keeps its id too. So this one was never scheduled.

hints.value: Open the version you were reading about and use its list of matches.

profile.title: Nobody here goes by that name.
profile.body: A profile exists once somebody has signed in, whether or not they have entered anything. This handle has not, or it is spelled differently — handles are GitHub's, and capitalisation does not matter but nothing else about the spelling is forgiven.

route.title: That page is not part of this site.
route.body: Some early links pointed at pages that no longer exist as pages. Games and seasons are chosen in the switcher in the header, not walked to: the home page in a past season is `/?season=summer-2026`, and the leaderboard for one game is `/leaderboard?game=ants`.

hints.value: Open the home page and pick the game and season you wanted; the address you land on is the one to keep.
That is our bug, not yours.

api.title: We could not reach the API.
api.body: This is not a missing page. Whatever you asked for is very probably there — the part of TinyBrains that answers questions did not answer this one. Nothing has been lost: versions, ratings and finished matches are stored, not held in this page.
api.unreachable: The API could not be reached.
api.notJson: The API answered with something that is not JSON.

inline.unreachable: {what} could not be loaded — the API did not answer. This is not an empty list.

crash.title: This page stopped drawing.
crash.body: Not a missing page and not your connection: this site failed to render what it was given. Nothing has been lost — versions, ratings and finished matches are stored, not held in this page.
crash.moreHeading: If it keeps happening on one page
more: Every other page very probably still works — each is drawn by its own code.
It is our bug, not your link. The message below is what a report should carry.

signIn.body: Sign in with GitHub to see this. There is no separate account to create — your GitHub login is the whole account.

admin.title: This page is for administrators.
admin.bodySignedIn: Your account is not an administrator. Admin pages are linked from an administrator’s account menu.
admin.bodySignedOut: Sign in with an administrator account to use it.

cap.unmeasured: It has not been measured yet — admission does that, and it decides the class.
cap.noCap: This version has no class cap recorded, so there is nothing to measure it against.
cap.over: Over the cap by {size}, which is why it was refused.

plot.caption: Every version on this ladder, its measured size across on a logarithmic scale against the rating it has earned, over bands that are the season’s weight classes. Each mark is a link to that version’s page, and the ladder’s table is the same rows.
plot.empty: nothing rated on this ladder yet
